scope: Two successive adapters, executed held-out gameplay; original protocol remains immutable

training.loss: mean assistant target token loss per example, equal example weighting

round1.sample_order: one seeded permutation of all 320 rows

round2.correction_source: round1 executed episodes on four train fixtures only
round2.acceptance: different corrective action executed from exact pre-action native state and successful scripted continuation through original full horizon
round2.history: actual round1 attempted actions, never replaced by teacher history
round2.mixture: 160 original rows and 160 verified correction rows; seeded sampling with replacement if fewer corrections
round2.zero_verified_corrections: stop as blocked; never substitute a repeated unchanged-data pass

final_evaluation.test_opening_gate: both selected adapters and configurations hashed and locked before any final test episode

claims: Training loss alone is not improvement; report unchanged or worse gameplay results honestly. Single training seed, small same-geometry fixture pilot.
